title: Dark Chocolate Lava Cake
description: Individual molten chocolate cakes with a warm, gooey center. Simple yet utterly decadent — the perfect restaurant-quality dessert at home.
ingredients: 100g unsalted butter, plus extra for greasing
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C (390°F). Butter 4 ramekins and dust with cocoa powder.
Melt chocolate and butter together in a heatproof bowl over simmering water. Stir until smooth. Let cool slightly.
Beat eggs, egg yolks, and sugar with an electric mixer until pale and thick, about 3 minutes.
Fold chocolate mixture into the egg mixture gently.
Sift in flour and salt, fold until just combined.
Divide batter equally among prepared ramekins.
Bake exactly 10-12 minutes — the edges should be set but center should still wobble.
Run a knife around the edge and invert onto plates. Serve immediately with vanilla ice cream.
author: Chef Marie
